create_DPTDepthModel: create a DPTDepthModel instance with a pretrained checkpoint path and non-negative depth output
run_DPTDepthModel_forward: run the DPTDepthModel forward pass on an input image tensor to predict depth
build_DPT_with_custom_head: build a DPT model with a custom head module and vitb_rn50_384 backbone
create_fusion_block: create a FeatureFusionBlock_custom using _make_fusion_block with specified features and batch norm settings
review_DPT_forward: review the DPT forward pass that extracts four ViT layers and refines them through a cascaded path
